title: works
text: works. Bought 3 of these... one for myself, my husband and my mother as we were all traveling together.  It is a very nice memory foam neck pillow.  The cover does zip off for cleaning.  Not super easy to put the cover back on, but better than not being able to clean it.  I would say it is about as good as any memory foam neck pillow. Worked as well as others I have owned. It does have a very loose strap that you could slide over your suitcase handle... but it stretches out so easily after a few times doing this, it will probably hang to the ground or break. So I would suggest for light travel.  I purchased for on amazon at a supposedly reduced price (woo hoo 50% off, but that makes it a realistic price) that I think was a fair price not a terrific deal.  It arrive in a fair amount of time (I have prime) and in good condition.
